subject: Demo recap — proposed POC activation roadmap
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Gomez <marta.gomez@verdantlogic.io>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@verdantlogic.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap — proposed POC activation roadmap

Hi Marta / Samir —

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation and some clear signals that Verdant Logic could benefit from improving retrieval latency for contextual search in your field-ops app. Per our call, attached is a concise POC charter and a suggested activation roadmap so you have a single doc to share with stakeholders. High level summary below and next steps I propose.

Quick recap from the demo (2 key opportunities):
- Reduce average query latency from ~420ms to sub-200ms for 50% of queries by using Redwood batching + KV-caching.
- Cut per-user inference cost 25–35% via quantized model variant and prefix caching for repeated prompts.

Proposed POC (4 weeks):
1) Week 0 (prep): access, test dataset, success criteria sign-off.
2) Week 1 (pilot deploy): small dedicated capacity, end-to-end integration with your QA dataset.
3) Week 2 (stress & tuning): throughput tuning, cache policies, quantization profile testing.
4) Week 3 (acceptance & handover): acceptance test, runbook, performance report.

Success criteria (proposal — happy to adjust):
- Latency: p50 < 200ms, p95 < 400ms for target queries.
- Cost: token cost reduction >= 25% vs baseline.
- Functional: top-3 retrieval accuracy uplift >= 10% on labeled set.

Owners & roles (suggested):
- Redwood PM / AE: Stephanie Nguyen — engagement lead, commercial coordination.
- Redwood SRE / Solutions: Marcus Lin — infra & deploy, onboarding config.
- Verdant technical lead: Samir Patel — data access, validation datasets.
- Verdant product sponsor: Marta Gomez — executive sign-off and success criteria.

Attachments included: verdant_poc_charter_v1.pdf (POC scope + acceptance checklist), redwood_trial_config.yaml (baseline config sample).

Immediate next steps I suggest:
- Marta / Samir: confirm success criteria and dataset access by EOD Tue (Aug 31).
- If agreed, Marcus and I will schedule a 60‑minute kickoff (tech + network) for Wed or Thu next week.
- I can circulate a brief SOW/activation checklist for signatures after kickoff.

Thanks — look forward to moving quickly if this maps to your priorities.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0187

Attachments: verdant_poc_charter_v1.pdf, redwood_trial_config.yaml

From: Marta Gomez <marta.gomez@verdantlogic.io>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@verdantlogic.io>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap — proposed POC activation roadmap

Thanks Stephanie — appreciate the clear recap. A couple quick clarifying Qs before I loop in procurement and our infra team: 

1) Data access: for the labeled set you referenced, can we run the POC against a sampled anonymized export? We need to verify no PII leaves our environment.
2) Cost accounting: will Redwood provide per-token breakdowns by route/model in the POC reporting (we need this for our internal chargeback)?
3) Can you confirm whether the dedicated capacity option requires long-term commit or if you offer a short-term reserved pool for trials?

Also, Samir — can you confirm the name on the infra side who will be our point-of-contact for network/firewall rules?

Thanks — Marta
Marta Gomez
Head of Product | Verdant Logic
marta.gomez@verdantlogic.io

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Gomez <marta.gomez@verdantlogic.io>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@verdantlogic.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap — proposed POC activation roadmap

Marta — thanks for the quick questions. Answers inline and added a short acceptance checklist below. Marcus also added a one-line tech pre-req at the bottom.

1) Data access: Yes — we can run entirely against an anonymized sample. For the POC we only need a representative sample (~25–50k rows depending on document size). We'll provide a checklist for fields to remove; no data will leave your VPC if you prefer a private deployment.

2) Cost reporting: We will provide token-level breakdowns by route/model in the Redwood Console for the POC and exportable CSVs. I'll add a token cost summary to the final performance report.

3) Dedicated capacity for trials: For a short POC we have a "trial reserved pool" option (no long-term commitment) — Marcus will spin up a small pool for the 4-week window; we can convert to a committed Dedicated seat later if you want predictable throughput.

Proposed acceptance checklist (finalized during kickoff):
- Baseline run completed using your sample dataset (shared hash to confirm sample).
- Performance target: p50 < 200ms, p95 < 400ms across target queries.
- Cost target: >= 25% per-token reduction vs baseline on selected routes.
- Functional target: top-3 retrieval accuracy uplift >= 10% on labeled subset.
- Security: anonymization confirmed, HMAC hash of dataset sample file provided to Redwood (for audit).

Ownership & immediate asks:
- Verdant: confirm dataset sample location + infra POC contact (Samir? a different name?) by EOD Tue Aug 31.
- Redwood: Marcus will post the trial config and firewall rules; Laura will coordinate SOW and procurement items after kickoff.

Marcus' tech pre-req (from Marcus):
> Temporary SSH jumpbox + CIDR allowlist for Redwood trial pool OR VPC peering; list of outbound domains to allow (redwood-inference.net, api.redwood-inference.net).

Next steps:
- If you confirm the above, I'll schedule the kickoff (60m) — proposed window Wed Sep 1 (10:00–11:00 PDT) or Thu Sep 2 (09:00–10:00 PDT). Which works better?

Thanks — I attached the updated redwood_trial_config.yaml and reattached the POC charter to this thread.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: redwood_trial_config.yaml, verdant_poc_charter_v1.pdf

We look forward to the trial — once we get the kickoff on the calendar we'll route any procurement requests to Laura.
